Use implementation only for a defect demonstrated by inspected evidence. Use verification when evidence could not be read or was insufficient. Suggested tasks are advisory; approval criteria define the required outcome and must not force one implementation. Every problem, blocking limitation, or requested follow-up mentioned in the rationale or evidence must also appear as one structured finding.
